title: 16 of 20 got better. Did the pill work?
hook: Most people who took a new pill felt better within a week. What does that tell you?

doesNotKnow: that many conditions improve with no treatment, so improvement after a treatment means nothing without a comparison group

misconception: If most people who took a treatment got better, the treatment worked.
objective: The learner can explain that to credit a treatment you must compare with a group that did not get it, because people often get better anyway.

claims.text: In the stage's model both groups recover on the same schedule; 16 of 20 are better by day 7 in each (3 of 20 by day 3).
claims.source: Lesson code: DAYS = [2,3,3,4,4,4,5,5,5,5,6,6,6,6,7,7,8,9,10,12] (brief 57); both rows are permutations of DAYS (PILL_ORDER, NONE_ORDER). Days <= 7: 16 entries; days <= 3: 3 entries.
claims.note: Derivation re-run in node: PILL_ORDER and NONE_ORDER are both permutations of 0..19, so both rows hold the same day list; days <= 3: 3 of 20, days <= 7: 16 of 20 in each row.

claims.text: In this model colds clear up by themselves, so getting better after the pill was going to happen anyway; without a group that did not get the treatment, an improvement cannot be credited to the treatment. Only the comparison row shows what the pill added, and here it added nothing.
claims.source: The treatment's effect in the model is the difference between the treated and untreated rows (the counterfactual comparison); both rows are the same day list, so the difference is 0 at every day. Brief 57 planned claim 2.
claims.note: Derivation: the model effect is the treated count minus the untreated count, which is 0 on every day because the rows hold the same list. 'Colds clear up by themselves' is stated as the model ('In this model'), not as a fact about real colds.

claims.text: The pill and the cold's recovery schedule are invented for the card; no real medicine is named.
claims.source: Lesson rule (brief 57 planned claim 3); stated on the stage caption 'Invented cold, invented pill.'
claims.note: Convention, consistent: the caption 'Invented cold, invented pill.' is on the stage, and no medicine is named in Demo.tsx or meta.json.

recall.question: A town paints its crossings and road injuries fall the next year. What would you most want to know before crediting the paint?
options: What happened in similar towns that did not paint
recall.why: Injuries can fall without any change. Only a comparison group that did not get the treatment shows what the treatment added.
